text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"three reasons with examples and a conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"It develops its point in a more structured way, with an introduction, separate supporting paragraphs, examples, and a closing statement."},{"evidence":"\"The first reason\"; \"The second reason\"; \"The third reason\"","quality":"paragraph development","description":"It expands each main idea more fully with extended explanation rather than brief assertions."},{"evidence":"\"you never know what someone is going through\"; \"made that person feel so much better and worthy\"","quality":"elaboration","description":"It adds more detail and context to explain ideas instead of stating them only in general terms."},{"evidence":"\"For example , I partnered up with a girl in our math class\"","quality":"specific anecdotal support","description":"It supports its claims with concrete personal incidents that make the writing more convincing and grounded."},{"evidence":"multiple connected sentences within each reason","quality":"sentence variety","description":"It shows greater control of longer, connected sentences that carry ideas across clauses."}]}
